item.title: Banjo & Kazooie
item.description:
Overview

Banjo’s a winning matchup for Bayo. Main reasons for this are his bad physics for escaping combos, meaning he takes a lot of damage and can die from some combos if his sdi isn’t the best. Plus his damage output is very low, specially compared to Bayo’s

item.title: Game&Watch
item.description:
Overview

Game&Watch is an even matchup for Bayo. Reasons are mostly because he’s broken as a character, insane neutral, advantage and disadvantage. What makes it even for Bayo are her explosiveness with her combos, witch time and good disadvantage, which makes the matchup winnable. Still, GaW can be very hard to kill at times and have an unbreakable defense while being very punishing with his combos and ledgetrap, so patience and spacing are key in succeeding against him.

item.title: Ness
item.description:
Overview

Ness goes even versus Bayonetta. He’s small and hard-hitting, with decent ledgetrap, incredible neutral, has a very potent backthrow that kills around 110-120% from center-stage and can put up good damage with the right combos. Bayo’s biggest strength in this matchups is her overall better damage output per opening and advantage, since ness struggles to land, recover and get off the ledge.
